summary: Early-career operations and customer service professional with about 4 years of combined experience spanning delivery dispatch and route management, medical office administration with patient billing and front-desk operations, and entry-level construction work. Has managed bicycle and tricycle delivery routes, dispatched couriers against time and budget targets, and tracked delivery performance metrics with reporting to warehouse managers. Brings hands-on experience with patient billing data, appointment scheduling, and facility safety procedures, plus Microsoft Office proficiency and a background in team leadership through captaining competitive basketball teams.
